entity_encoding: character offsets into sentence; X = head/source, Y = tail/target; spans must match sentence substrings exactly

output.checkpoint: output dir holds fine-tuned weights plus training manifest

split_rule: construction_family_id + pair_id steer the split and must never reach the model as features
change_scope: infrastructure only: dual-view target generation (entity labels dense, relation targets sparse-exclusive). No hypothesis change; labels, populations, folds, splits, seed, LRs, loss coefs, thresholds unchanged.
entity_mapping_rule: training entity spans are supervised under their source production type (entity_labels X/Y); training prompts offer the full production inventory plus provides; entity types are supervision classes, never model input features

training_regime.rationale: test whether the gold pair learns provides alignment when competing relation priors cannot absorb the mass; gold-pair info stays in training labels only, inference path untouched
